title: Coherent modules on Noetherian schemes are pseudo-coherent
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then $\mathcal F$, viewed as a complex concentrated in degree zero, is pseudo-coherent over $\mathcal O_Y$ in the sense of [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex].

proof.text: For every point $x\in Y$, apply [lem-sc-coherent-affine-free-resolution]. It gives an affine neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and a bounded-above cochain complex of finite-rank free $\mathcal O_U$-modules with a quasi-isomorphism to $\mathcal F|_U[0]$. This is exactly the local condition in [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex] for the complex $\mathcal F[0]$; since the construction works at every point, $\mathcal F[0]$ is pseudo-coherent on $Y$.
